bhūpati：ဘူ-ပတိ （ပ）
မင်း။ ရှင်ဘုရင်။
DOP: 1 bhū f. [ ts ] ( sg. loc. bhuvi; cf Sadd 238, 10 foll. ), 1. being, existence; Dhātup 373 (asa bhuvi); Dhātum 600; Sadd 450, 10 (asa bhuvi); — 2. the earth; the ground; Abh 182; 1052 (mahī … bhuvi); 1059; Ap 539, 31 (sokaṭṭā bhuvi pātitā, Ee so; Be bhūmipātitā; Ce, Se bhūmipātikā); Vism 68, 29* (ākaṅkhamāno bhuvi sericāraṃ); Mhv 64:46 (sabbān’ etāni lokamhi yāv’ ajjadivasā bhuvi); Sadd 84, 18 (~ū vuccati paṭhavī); — 3. thriving, welfare; Ps III 165, 3 (~ū ti vaḍḍhi); — °- dhara , m. , a mountain; Abh 605; — °- nātha , m. , a king; Abh 334; — °- pa , m. [bhū + pa 4 ], a king; Abh 335; Mhv 11:38; 17:54; — °- pati , m. [bhū + pati 2 ], a king; a ruler; Abh 333; Paṭis-a 704, 2* ; Mhv 2:12; 5:72; — °- pāla , m. , a king; Abh 333; Mhv 37:170; Sadd 238, 13 ; — °- bhuja , m. [bhū + bhuja 2 ], a king; Abh 334; Sadd 238, 13 ; — °- ruha , m. [bhū + ruha 1 ], a tree; Sadd 238, 13 ; — °- saṇhakaraṇī , f. , an instrument for smoothing the earth; Abh 1007 (pāṇi … ~iyaṃ mato); — see also bhūmi-; — abhū , f. , absence of thriving; destruction; Ps III 165, 3 (abhū ti avaḍḍhi, vināso mayhan ti attho); — see also abbhu(ṃ).
